title: Higher-order strongly monotone variational inequalities on compact convex sets with tangent residual
summary: Complete feasible operator jets determine the optimal polynomial condition exponent for constrained strongly monotone VIs; root finding and solution-distance tasks remain separate.

description_paragraphs: Solve the variational inequality $0\in F(x)+N_X(x)$ on a known compact convex set by returning a feasible point with small tangent residual.
task.formulation: Solve the variational inequality $0\in F(x)+N_X(x)$ on a known compact convex set by returning a feasible point with small tangent residual.

description_paragraphs: Fix an integer $p\ge2$. The public set $X\subseteq\mathbb R^d$ is nonempty compact convex with diameter at most D, and a feasible start x_0 is supplied. The operator is $C^{p-1}$ on an open neighborhood of X and satisfies $\langle F(x)-F(y),x-y\rangle\ge\mu\|x-y\|_2^2$ and $\|D^{p-1}F(x)-D^{p-1}F(y)\|_{\rm op}\le L_p\|x-y\|_2$ on X.

The positive mu and L_p are lower and upper promises, not necessarily sharp moduli. No scalar potential or bound on lower derivatives is imposed. The unique VI solution need not be a zero of F, especially at the boundary. All norms are Euclidean induced multilinear operator norms.

description_paragraphs: At a feasible point return the exact complete operator jet $(F,DF,\ldots,D^{p-1}F)$. Count every call, including calls inside regularized subproblems, unsuccessful radius guesses, restarts and a final certificate check. Projections onto the known domain and exact solves of models formed only from returned jets are uncharged internal operations. An unknown-operator resolvent is not supplied for free.

description_paragraphs: Return any measurable feasible point $\widehat x\in X$, possibly unqueried. The upper witness additionally returns an evaluated certificate $(\widehat x,n,F(\widehat x))$ with $n\in N_X(\widehat x)$ and a charged evaluation of F at the output.
output.feasibility: Return any measurable feasible point $\widehat x\in X$, possibly unqueried. The upper witness additionally returns an evaluated certificate $(\widehat x,n,F(\widehat x))$ with $n\in N_X(\widehat x)$ and a charged evaluation of F at the output.

description_paragraphs: The error is $r_{\rm tan}(x)=\operatorname{dist}(0,F(x)+N_X(x))$. Here $N_X(x)=\{n:\langle n,u-x\rangle\le0\text{ for all }u\in X\}$. The probability guarantee concerns this residual itself, not the root residual or distance to the solution.

description_paragraphs: One complete jet costs one query. A deterministic cap holds on every path for arbitrary measurable adaptive policies, and queries and outputs must stay feasible. The dimension-uniform comparison takes the worst case over all finite d, all legal public domains and starts, and all compatible operators.

description_paragraphs: Queries, stopping decisions and outputs are arbitrary measurable functions of the observed history and public inputs. No linear-span or zero-respecting restriction is imposed. Internal exact-real computation and storage are uncharged.
A private random seed independent of the fixed instance is permitted.
The objective operator and domain are fixed before the independent private seed; feasibility and the query cap hold on every path.

regimes.predicate_text: $p\ge2$ fixed, $\kappa_D\ge\kappa_{0,p}$, $0<\theta\le1/16$, and $\log_+(1/\theta)\le\kappa_D^{2/(3p-1)}$. This includes each fixed relative accuracy as kappa_D tends to infinity. The upper bound is valid in every finite dimension. For the lower bound the public domain can be $B_2^d(D/2)$ with start zero. Let $m=\lfloor(c_p^{\rm sc}\kappa_D)^{2/(3p-1)}\rfloor$, with $c_p^{\rm sc}$ from equation lower-constants. Any $d\ge m+\lceil2048m^3\ln(8(m^2+1))\rceil$ suffices. The explicit source threshold is $\kappa_{0,p}=2^{(3p-1)/2}/c_p^{\rm sc}$. This is a sufficient high-dimensional construction, not a claim for every fixed small d.
